decision: The directed prior-stage preparation proposal is coherent and preferable to permanent per-goal exceptions. It changes only the QA meaning of an incoming preparation proof; it must not broaden terminal proofs, source applicability or learner targets. The two whole-goal prerequisite decisions remain decisive and unchanged.
whyNotMetadataInference: Existing stage selectors can remain compatibility routing selectors for these explicit QA profiles. E/Q2 does not establish a mathematical obligation to depend on the SekII orientation. The profile change permits already reviewed earlier preparation; it grants no official curriculum, acquisition level or source claim from phase. A future migration to authoritative placement is separate.

explicitProfileContract.direction: In requires traversal from consumer to preparation, SekII may enter SekI once, then remain in SekI until its anchor. No SekI->SekII return, unknown/future stage or arbitrary anchor pooling.
explicitProfileContract.incomingProof: Accept either the existing path entirely in the current stage to its own anchor, or a genuine direct-atomic path beginning in current stage, crossing to earlier stage, containing at least one earlier ordinary curricular atomic prerequisite, and ending at that earlier orientation. A direct edge to the other anchor alone is not evidence of an earlier mathematical preparation basis.
explicitProfileContract.terminalProof: For every selected SekII curricular goal, independently require an onward assessment in the existing SekII terminal population, with every node on the consumer-to-terminal segment in SekII. Earlier-stage exams and paths that leave/reenter SekII cannot discharge this segment.
explicitProfileContract.earlierProfile: SekI remains self-contained; its incoming and terminal proofs may not traverse SekII. Earlier preparation nodes still face the ordinary SekI profile checks; acceptance as earlier preparation does not exempt their own requirements or terminal coverage.
explicitProfileContract.scopeMembership: Do not widen goalSelector or terminalGoalSelector to include all prior-stage goals. Prior-stage proof nodes are incoming support only. Preserve curricularAtomic population, current terminal folders/additional assessment selector and ordinary-content requirement for terminals.
explicitProfileContract.ambiguousMembership: Do not silently give a node a favorable stage when compatibility predicates overlap or have no membership. Any bridge node must resolve to the explicit prior/current proof role, otherwise it cannot certify this earlier-stage alternative.
explicitProfileContract.GVR011: Keep effective-requires compatibility as the existing weaker connectivity lane, but restrict accepted stage paths consistently. An earlier-stage alternative must be positively witnessed by the same directed direct-atomic preparation relation used for GVR012; inherited cluster shortcuts cannot manufacture it.
explicitProfileContract.GVR012: Use separate preparation-proof and current-stage terminal-proof relations. Do not merely enlarge routeGoalSelector and motivationAnchorGoalIds globally. Apply the new preparation predicate consistently to selected curricular goals, terminal incoming checks, ordinary-content-through-terminal checks and relevant memory/order participants.
unchangedGuards: All selected goals remain curricularAtomic and atomic.
Both orientations must be real atomic prerequisite-free orientation nodes.
Terminal assessment role and complete released task/rubric metadata remain mandatory.
Ordinary curricular content must lie on each terminal route as required today.
Every current validity/order finding remains; a valid incoming branch never waives another malformed, non-atomic, wrong-kind or reversed prerequisite.
DAG checks and stage-specific composition orientation visibility remain.
No new requires, coverage, mastery, scopes, program levels or runtime selection behavior.

requiredImplementationEvidence: Update all conflicting GVR011/012 documentation statements explicitly; no silent rule reinterpretation.
Unit regression of all proposed countercases plus existing malformed terminal, non-atomic prerequisite, role reversal and memory-order tests.
Actual full current graph before/after finding multiset, explain each changed finding, retain every unrelated current failure. Do not assume only four messages disappear.
Bind actual source hashes and full current input hashes; no M7/remote/full acceptance until normal producer checks pass.
nextStep: Root may explicitly commission this bounded contract implementation and its independent review; this is a design decision proposal, not imported code or a waived current finding.
